cand.title: Gulf ports coach that interrupts at the right second — photo packing
cand.pitch: Geometry-aware packing optimizer from photos: Photograph the space, SAM 3.1 gives the geometry, an optimizer returns the arrangement that fits with clearances verified by mask math — no CAD, just a phone. Winner-DNA insight - real-time multimodal feedback on a human performance feels like magic and demos in 60s. Applied to fishing ports along the Gulf, where catch landing sheets become decisions, not paperwork. Stack: SAM 3.1 + Muse Spark + Muse Image. Nov
cand.twist: output exportable to the tools people already use
